sources.excerpt: Apr 2, 2009 · Despite myths to the contrary, the wall isn't visible from the

reasoning: The claim that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye is a well-documented myth. According to NASA and accounts from numerous astronauts, the Great Wall is not visible to the naked eye from space (even from Low Earth Orbit) because it is narrow and its construction materials blend in with the surrounding natural terrain. It is completely invisible from the Moon. Conversely, other human-made structures—such as major highways, airport runways, dams, and cities illuminated at night—are visible from Low Earth Orbit with the naked eye.
